note: DRAFT positional playbook layering on nda_v1.json. Each rule carries Starting / Fallback / Dealbreaker positions for clauses with negotiable numeric or enumerated values. presence/absence rules stay in nda_v1.json -- they have no position ladder. No in-house lawyer has approved these positions.
applies_to: Mutual non-disclosure agreements governed by Indian law
not_legal_advice: Every finding is a POTENTIAL_ISSUE against a company standard, not a statement of law.

rules.why: Shorter confidentiality is easier to administer. 2 years is the starting ask; 3 years is market standard; above 5 years is unusual for a mutual NDA and flags NEEDS_LAWYER.
The survival period protects after the NDA ends. Firm wants at least 3 years; 2 is acceptable; below 1 year the protection is effectively meaningless.
Foreign governing law makes enforcement slower and more expensive. No dealbreaker set because foreign law isn't automatically rejected -- it goes to NEEDS_LAWYER via falling through all positions.
Arbitration seat determines procedural law and court supervision. Mumbai is preferred; any Indian metro is acceptable; foreign seat falls through to NOT_ACCEPTABLE.
Liability on a mutual NDA should be proportionate. 50L is the starting ask; 1-2Cr is market; above 5Cr on a mutual NDA is disproportionate.

rules.applicability: Only if the NDA has a termination-for-convenience clause
rules.why: Notice period for termination. Uses equals comparator because the years/amount parsers do not handle day values. A min_days comparator can be added when needed.
